source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in {v for row in grid for v in row}}
    marker = min((v for v in counts if v != 0), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, x in enumerate(row) if x == marker]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = {(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in cells}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - (r1 - r0 + 1) + 1):
        for c in range(w - (c1 - c0 + 1) + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
